cards.ex: Donating $5 is a drop in the ocean compared to what they really need.
cards.exUz: 5 dollar ehson qilish ular aslida kerak bo'lgan narsaga nisbatan dengizdan tomchi.

cards.ex: You should bundle up before going outside; it's freezing!
cards.exUz: Tashqariga chiqishdan oldin issiq o'ranib oling, juda sovuq!
cards.uzDef: Sovuqdan himoyalanish uchun issiq kiyim kiyish.

cards.ex: The company managed to weather the economic storm and stay afloat.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya iqtisodiy bo'ronni boshdan kechirib, suzib yurishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

cards.ex: I only go to the cinema once in a blue moon.
cards.exUz: Men kinoga oyda bir marta boraman.

cards.ex: I'm feeling a bit under the weather today, so I'm staying home.
cards.exUz: Men bugun o'zimni biroz mazasi yo'q his qilyapman, shuning uchun uyda qolaman.
cards.uzDef: Bemor bo'lish, o'zini yaxshi his qilmaslik.

cards.ex: We need to nip these rumors in the bud before they spread.
cards.exUz: Biz bu mish-mishlarning tarqalishidan oldin ularni yo'q qilishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: Despite his success, he's still very down to earth.
cards.exUz: Muvaffaqiyatiga qaramay, u hali ham juda oddiy.

cards.ex: His explanation was as clear as mud; I still don't understand.
cards.exUz: Uning tushuntirishi loyqadek tushunarsiz edi; men hali ham tushunmayapman.

cards.ex: I got wind of their plans to move to another city.
cards.exUz: Men ularning boshqa shaharga ko'chib o'tish rejalari haqida eshitib qoldim.

cards.ex: The exam was a walk in the park; I finished it in half an hour.
cards.exUz: Imtihon juda oson edi; Men uni yarim soatda tugatdim.
cards.uzDef: Juda oson va qiyinchiliksiz bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: There's nothing we can do; we just have to let nature take its course.
cards.exUz: Biz hech narsa qila olmaymiz; shunchaki tabiat o'z yo'lidan borishiga qo'yib berishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hodisalarning tabiiy ravishda rivojlanishiga yo'l qo'yish.

cards.ex: He's as stubborn as a mule; you'll never convince him.
cards.exUz: U xachirdek qaysar; uni hech qachon ishontira olmaysiz.

cards.ex: There's something fishy about this whole deal; I don't trust it.
cards.exUz: Bu bitimning hammasida bir shubhali narsa bor; men unga ishonmayman.

cards.ex: Ever since she got the promotion, she's been as happy as a clam.
cards.exUz: U lavozimga ko'tarilganidan beri u juda baxtiyor.

cards.ex: We can't go outside; it's raining cats and dogs!
cards.exUz: Biz tashqariga chiqa olmaymiz; yomg'ir seldek yog'yapti!

cards.ex: Let's get off the beaten path and explore some hidden gems.
cards.exUz: Keling, tanho yo'ldan yurib, yashirin durdonalarni o'rganamiz.

cards.ex: They always think the grass is always greener on the other side.
cards.exUz: Ular doim boshqalarda yaxshiroq narsalar bor deb o'ylashadi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarda har doim yaxshiroq narsalar bor deb o'ylash.

cards.ex: We're all in the same boat when it comes to job security.
cards.exUz: Ish xavfsizligi masalasida hammamiz bir qayiqdamiz.

cards.ex: Learning to ride a bike is as easy as pie.
cards.exUz: Velosiped haydashni o'rganish pirogdek oson.

cards.ex: Flowers always brighten up a room.
cards.exUz: Gullar har doim xonani yorqinlashtiradi.
cards.uzDef: Kayfiyatni yaxshilash yoki joyni yorqinroq qilish.

cards.ex: A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.
cards.exUz: Qo'ldagi qush butadagi ikkita qushdan afzal.

cards.ex: The patient is finally out of the woods after the surgery.
cards.exUz: Operatsiyadan so'ng bemor nihoyat xavfdan xalos bo'ldi.

cards.ex: If you think he's going to help you, you're barking up the wrong tree.
cards.exUz: Agar u sizga yordam beradi deb o'ylasangiz, noto'g'ri yo'ldasiz.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri odamdan yordam so'rash yoki noto'g'ri narsaga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: His opinion goes against the grain of popular thinking.
cards.exUz: Uning fikri mashhur fikrlashga zid.

cards.ex: I'm going to the beach to catch some rays.
cards.exUz: Men plyajga quyoshlanishga bormoqchiman.

cards.ex: The garden is in full bloom in the spring.
cards.exUz: Bog' bahorda gullagan paytida bo'ladi.

cards.ex: The children were as quiet as mice during the movie.
cards.exUz: Bolalar kino paytida sichqondek tinch edilar.

cards.ex: I'm trying to cut down on sugar.
cards.exUz: Men shakar iste'molini kamaytirishga harakat qilyapman.

cards.ex: She's a ray of sunshine in my life.
cards.exUz: U mening hayotimda quyosh nuri.
cards.uzDef: Quvonch va umid olib keluvchi odam yoki narsa.

cards.ex: The crowd went wild when the band came on stage.
cards.exUz: Guruh sahnaga chiqqanda olomon jahl otiga mindi.
